{"metadata":{"description":"A DSH plugin that explicitly designs LLM agent orchestration as a control loop","id":"gh:1442809759","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-cybernetics","slug":"MarchLiu/dsh-cybernetics","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A DSH plugin that explicitly designs LLM agent orchestration as a control loop"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-cybernetics"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**dsh-cybernetics is a DSH plugin that explicitly designs LLM agent orchestration as a control loop*"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"*: the session goal persists as an artifact of the agent's thinking; the task agent acts, the verify"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" agent measures, the triage agent triages, the controller advances between rounds, and the user cali"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"brates the outer loop through conversation — a negative-feedback loop of goal, action, measurement, "},{"id":"p4s5","text":" loop through conversation — a negative-feedback loop of goal, action, measurement, and calibration."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The protocol takes its name from Wiener's cybernetics: set a goal (setpoint), act, measure the devia"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"tion of the output from the goal, and use that deviation to correct the next action. A traditional o"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ne-shot prompt is an open-loop system — the goal lives only inside the current prompt, and the burde"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"n of measurement falls entirely on the human; this project moves the loop into the system itself, tr"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"ansforming the human from "the author of prompts, one by one" into "the setter of goals and the cali"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"brator of the outer loop." The design rationale is described in the blog post "Cybernetics Agent — A"},{"id":"p5s7","text":" New Paradigm for AI Applications" (in Chinese)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Full protocol: docs/protocol.md (Chinese)
- Evolution history: docs/CHANGELOG.md (Chinese)"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Core Concepts"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Role | Responsibility |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| **session agent** | Orchestrator (controller): recognizes user input, maintains the goal board, st"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"arts/collects/cancels rounds, relays results to the user; never executes tasks itself |
| **controll"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"er** | The inter-round state machine in `src/controller.ts`: `startRound`/`foldRound`/`runRound`, ad"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"vancing the subgoal round by round (task → verify → triage), maintaining the audit log |
| **task ag"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ent** | Executor: an independent sub agent with no conversation history, actually executing against "},{"id":"p10s6","text":"the work-order brief, producing a structured delivery report |
| **verify agent** | Measuring instru"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ment: accepts/rejects independently of the executor, producing a structured verdict `{met, criteria,"},{"id":"p10s8","text":" gaps, goalItselfQuestionable}` |
| **triage agent** | Triage: sorts the follow-up leads exposed by "},{"id":"p10s9","text":"the verdict into four categories — auto / defer / reject / human |
| **User** | Outer-loop calibrato"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"r: calibrates through conversation (goal revisions go through the session agent's `revise`), adjudic"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"ates human-class items, confirms completion — the controller never declares completion by itself |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**goal** is a first-class, persistent state (objective + current subgoal + full work-order brief), b"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"uilt on top of the dsh-goal service; since v0.2 it no longer depends on a goal.md file. The inner lo"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"op (task → verify → triage → subgoal correction) iterates automatically while the goal is unchanged,"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" with a per-round cap on consecutive iterations as a backstop; the outer loop (user ↔ session agent)"},{"id":"p11s5","text":" intervenes only when the goal itself is in question — a verdict with `goalItselfQuestionable=true` "},{"id":"p11s6","text":"forbids automatic iteration and forces a return to conversation."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### All-goals mode (`allGoalsMode`, default false)"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"When enabled, injects the "ALL-GOALS MODE ACTIVE" routing protocol: **every user request first creat"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"es a goal, then executes**; the session agent is forbidden from completing tasks in place with read "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"tools — even a single-file lookup or one calculation goes through the loop. Simple read-only request"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"s → a single `quick` round; complex analysis / write tasks → progressive multi-round `full` (async `"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"start` + round-by-round `collect` convergence). When the mode is off, the prompt segments and revise"},{"id":"p14s6","text":" behavior are exactly the same as v0.6."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Hard gate (`hardGate`, default true — active out of the box; v0.8.10: toggleable on the settings"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"rd gate (`hardGate`, default true — active out of the box; v0.8.10: toggleable on the settings card)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**Hot toggle (v0.8.10).** `hardGate` is a **volatile** field: the plugins-page settings card renders"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" a live switch for it. Saving the toggle commits into the running instance and the plugin disposes o"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"r (re)installs the gate listeners (assembly strip + dispatch deny + approval relay) immediately — no"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" restart, no plugin reload. A hot false→true re-derives the mode from the current `gateMode` resolut"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ion (explicit config wins; otherwise the structural allowlist). The other gate fields (`gateMode`/`g"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"atedTools`/`gateAllowlist`/`gateAllowlistExtra`/`gateApprovalRelay`) remain non-volatile config-docu"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"ment fields; edit those in the profile config document (saving triggers a plugin reload). Deployment"},{"id":"p16s8","text":" nuance: the first time this build ships, the running host still holds the pre-0.8.10 code — restart"},{"id":"p16s9","text":" the host once to load it; after that the toggle is hot (`lib/client.js` needs only a browser refres"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"e host once to load it; after that the toggle is hot (`lib/client.js` needs only a browser refresh)."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Known Limitations"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"1. **Host defect in settings writes**: as described in the "Plugin-page configuration" section, on t"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"his runtime, card saves may be rejected by the host before reaching disk (upstream #12045); workarou"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"nds: restart the host + hard-refresh the browser, or manual patch rows + restart.
2. **Save-semantic"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"s difference between volatile and non-volatile fields**: volatile fields (`allGoalsMode`, `hardGate`"},{"id":"p19s5","text":" since v0.8.10, `taskAgentModel`, `verifyAgentModel`, `triageAgentModel`, `roundsPerSubgoal`, `maxCo"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"ncurrentRounds`) take effect immediately on save without remount; non-volatile fields (`roles` since"},{"id":"p19s7","text":" v0.8.4, `gateMode`, `gatedTools`, `gateAllowlist*`, `gateApprovalRelay`, `toolName`, `implicitTrigg"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"er`) trigger a plugin-row remount on save, requiring a host reload to complete. Moreover, the host s"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"ettings form only serves and only accepts volatile paths — if the running host's schema is too old, "},{"id":"p19s10","text":"even volatile writes are rejected (a restart fixes it).
3. **`link:` installation caveats**: the cli"},{"id":"p19s11","text":"ent bundle's registration id must equal the package.json `name` (`@mars.liu/dsh-cybernetics`); the l"},{"id":"p19s12","text":"oader row id may use the short name `dsh-cybernetics`. The plugin must hang at the **top level** of "},{"id":"p19s13","text":"the profile's loader entries (the client scan enumerates only top-level rows); `src/` changes requir"},{"id":"p19s14","text":"e a host reload, `lib/` changes require a host restart + browser refresh.
4. Other protocol boundari"},{"id":"p19s15","text":"es (the hard gate operating at the assembly layer rather than the execution layer, dsh-goal's focus "},{"id":"p19s16","text":"slot not migrating on supersede, etc.) are covered in the "Known Boundaries" subsections of docs/pro"},{"id":"p19s17","text":"migrating on supersede, etc.) are covered in the "Known Boundaries" subsections of docs/protocol.md."}],"truncated":true}
